boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented campus destinations for studying, recreation, performances, games, and meals.

cards.title: Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Library study and co-working space
cards.notes: Bring a project or reading list, then choose group or individual workspace; the library also has computer labs, WiFi and wireless printing.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with individual and group work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Friedsam Memorial Library offers group and individual study/work space, two computer labs, wireless printing and WiFi.
cards.access_notes: Library policies apply; alcohol and tobacco products are prohibited in the building.

cards.entity_name: Sandra A. and William L. Richter Center
cards.title: Richter Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation and fitness facility
cards.notes: Plan an active break with the indoor track, courts, climbing wall or cardio equipment; check the university notice board for schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: A recreation center with courts, track and fitness facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Richter Center includes basketball courts, an indoor walking/running track, racquetball and squash courts, a climbing wall, and cardio and weight equipment.
cards.source_title: Activities, Programs & Recreation | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: University lists regular hours and notes that holiday, break and summer hours may change.

cards.entity_name: Bob Lanier Court in Reilly Center Arena
cards.title: Bob Lanier Court
cards.subtitle: Reilly Center Arena basketball court
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled Bonnies basketball game or attend with a valid event ticket; the university identifies the court as the home floor for both teams.
cards.short_summary: The home court for St. Bonaventure basketball.
cards.evidence_claim: Bob Lanier Court in Reilly Center Arena is home to St. Bonaventure's Division I men's and women's basketball teams.
cards.source_title: Athletic, Recreation & Fitness Facilities | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Game and event entry is subject to the university's current event and ticketing policies.

cards.title: Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Gaming space in the Reilly Center
cards.notes: Use the general-play computers or consoles when available, or stop by to see competition setups and the LED displays in the arena.
cards.short_summary: A campus gaming space with PCs and major consoles.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU's esports area has five competition PCs, 12 general-use computers, and Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch consoles for general gaming.
cards.source_title: Athletic, Recreation & Fitness Facilities | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Availability may vary for competition, programming and general student play.

cards.title: Reilly Center Swimming Pool
cards.subtitle: Pool beside Bob Lanier Court
cards.notes: Check for an open-swim session before heading over; the pool sits beside Bob Lanier Court and is used by the university's swimming and diving teams.
cards.short_summary: A campus pool used for team competition and open-swim sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reilly Center pool is home to SBU's men's and women's swimming and diving teams and is available during weekday open-swim sessions.
cards.source_title: Athletic, Recreation & Fitness Facilities | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Open-swim sessions are held during the week; verify the current schedule before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Allegheny River Valley Trail – Bonaventure Loop
cards.title: Bonaventure Loop on the Allegheny River Valley Trail
cards.subtitle: Campus connection to the regional trail
cards.notes: Start on the campus loop for a walk, run or ride, and stay on the paved trail; motorized vehicles are not permitted on the route.
cards.short_summary: A campus-accessible link to a paved regional trail.
cards.evidence_claim: A secondary Bonaventure loop brings the Allegheny River Valley Trail onto campus and reconnects with the main trail.
cards.source_title: Athletic, Recreation & Fitness Facilities | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Use the trail for permitted nonmotorized activities and follow posted trail conditions and rules.

cards.entity_name: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.title: Quick Center for the Arts
cards.subtitle: Visual and performing arts center
cards.notes: Check its program calendar or walk through the public-facing arts areas when open; the building combines theater, galleries, rehearsal rooms and classrooms.
cards.short_summary: A campus arts building with theater, galleries and rehearsal space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quick Center houses a 321-seat theater, art galleries and exhibit halls, instructional space, and music rehearsal rooms and suites.
cards.source_title: School of Arts & Sciences | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Performance, gallery and classroom access can vary by event and academic schedule.

cards.title: Walsh Science Center
cards.subtitle: Science classrooms, labs and amphitheater
cards.notes: Use the building as a landmark for science events or class work, and look for programming in its 150-seat indoor amphitheater.
cards.short_summary: A science building connecting laboratories, classrooms and an amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: The Walsh Science Center contains computer science, laboratory and classroom space, plus a 150-seat indoor amphitheater.
cards.source_title: School of Arts & Sciences | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Laboratories and classrooms may have course-specific or controlled access.

cards.title: Hickey Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Main-campus dining hall
cards.notes: Use your applicable meal plan or payment option for a meal near the residence halls; consult Dining Services for menus, locations and current service details.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining hall near the residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Bonaventure identifies Hickey Dining Hall as a campus dining location conveniently located near the main-campus residence halls.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires an applicable meal plan or other accepted payment; verify current menus and service.

cards.title: Café La Verna
cards.subtitle: Campus dining location
cards.notes: Use an applicable meal plan or payment option for a coffee or meal break, and verify current menu and service information with Dining Services.
cards.short_summary: One of the university-operated campus dining locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Dining Services lists Café La Verna among the university-operated campus dining locations.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require an applicable meal plan or other accepted payment; verify current service details.
